user.title: Connect to Provident
user.description: Sign in to the Provident (MeterConnex) utility portal to read your electricity, water, heating, cooling, and gas meters.

data_description.backfill_days: Days of hourly usage to import into the Energy dashboard when the account is first connected.

reconfigure.description: Change the account credentials used to reach the Provident portal.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Provident
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for account {username} no longer works. Enter the new password.

error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Provident account is already configured.

init.title: Provident rates
init.description: Price your electricity with the rates Provident publishes for your building. The cost covers energy and, optionally, Provident's administration and meter fees; it excludes delivery, regulatory charges, rebates, and HST.

data_description.rate_plan: The plan on your Provident bill. Changing it re-prices the imported cost history.
data_description.include_fees: Spread the monthly administration and meter fees evenly over every hour.
